title: A Thousand Years in Your Sight

request.style: English, Norwegian folk tune, kveding by an old man with a deep weathered voice, alone at first, then a low Hardanger fiddle drone, free rubato, Dorian mode, wistful and grave, 58 BPM, sung in English
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Lord, you have been our dwelling place
Through all generations
Before the mountains were born
From everlasting to everlasting you are God

[Verse]
You return mortals to dust
Saying, Return, you children of man
For a thousand years in your sight
Are like a day that has just gone by

[Verse]
Like grass that springs up in the morning
In the morning it blooms and flourishes
By evening it withers and dries up

[Outro]
From everlasting to everlasting you are God
